caption: A basket of wet laundry is hung from the middle of a clothesline strung between two posts, and the line sags under the weight.

sa.check: A clothesline is strung between two posts.
A basket of laundry is hung from the middle of the line.
The line sags under the weight.
The basket is hung first and the sag follows.

pc.expect: The sag forms as the basket is hung, deepest at the basket, with the line running straight from basket to each post.
pc.fail: The line stays level with the basket hanging; or it sags in a rounded droop away from the basket; or it stretches longer and longer.

pc.expect: The sag is downward and the basket hangs below the line's ends.
pc.fail: The line bows upward; or the basket rises; or the basket hangs out sideways.

pc.expect: The posts lean inward or the line tugs at them as the weight comes on.
pc.fail: The posts lean outward; or the line goes slack while the basket hangs; or the basket falls with the line intact and unbroken.

pc.expect: The basket swings a little and settles, and nothing else moves.
pc.fail: The basket swings harder and harder; or it slides along the line untouched; or the line moves before the basket is hung.

pc.expect: One line, one basket and two posts keep their number.
pc.fail: The basket vanishes or a second appears; or the line passes through the basket; or a post disappears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The basket, the laundry and the yard stay the same.
pc.fail: The basket changes colour; or the laundry changes; or the yard rearranges.
